We need propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have identified a template (id 29646) that matches target and corresponds to deprotection of TBS group: retro reaction: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O]-[C:2] (i.e., forward is protection). So step 1 (retro) would be removal of TBS protecting group to give a free alcohol.

Thus target has a TBS-protected alcohol? Let's examine target: O[C@H]1... The first O is free OH attached to chiral carbon. But there is also O[C@@H]([...]) maybe a TBS? Actually O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C) indicates an O attached to a carbon that is part of a side chain; could be an ether linking to a TBS? Wait TBS is Si with tBu and Me2 groups. The SMILES does not show Si. So maybe the target already has deprotected alcohols, and we need to protect later? The guidance says forward reactions include TBS protection, HWE, DIBAL-H, TMSOTf, Still-Gennari. So retrosynthesis steps will be reverse: deprotection, HWE reverse (i.e., olefination precursor is aldehyde + phosphonate), DIBAL-H reverse (i.e., oxidation of alcohol to aldehyde?), etc.

We need 5 reactions. Likely sequence:

1. Deprotect TBS (if present) – but target has no Si, so maybe earlier step had TBS protected, then deprotected to give target. So retro step: apply template 29646 to remove TBS, giving precursor with TBS group attached (i.e., a silyl ether). So precursor would be same molecule but with OSi(tBu)(Me)2 instead of OH at that position. Which OH? The O at start? Actually template matches a primary alcohol? The template is [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O]-[C:2]; So forward: protect alcohol with TBS. Retro: remove TBS to give alcohol. So our target has OH; retro step gives TBS-protected precursor.

Thus step1: target -> precursor1 (TBS-protected version). We'll need to generate that precursor using apply_template? Actually we need to propose route, not compute SMILES. But we need to provide JSON with reactions and children. We need template IDs for each step. We have template 29646 for deprotection. Need other templates for HWE (Still-Gennari) etc. We need to search for templates that correspond to HWE (formation of double bond from aldehyde + phosphonate). Search for functional groups: broken: aldehydes? formed: C-C double bonds. Let's search.
